paragraphs: The 730i and 740i were part of the G11/G12 generation of the 7 Series, produced from 2015 to 2022. Both variants use the B58 — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine that's part of BMW's modular B-series family. The B58 is a well-regarded unit, known for its robust construction and strong performance across a wide range of BMW models. The G11/G12 generation marked the switch from the previous N-series engines to the newer B-series architecture, bringing improvements in efficiency, reliability and power delivery. The 730i and 740i were discontinued when the G70 generation launched in 2022.
about.boldParagraph: The 730i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
